name: Iveco Group N.V.
summary: Iveco Group N.V. engages in the design, production, marketing, sale, servicing, and financing of trucks, commercial vehicles, buses, specialty vehicles, combustion engines, alternative propulsion systems, transmissions, axles, and engines in Europe, South America, North America, and internationally. It operates in four segments: Truck, Bus, Powertrain, and Financial Services. The company offers light, medium, and heavy vehicles for the transportation and distribution of goods under the IVECO brand; and minibuses, city buses, intercity buses, and coaches for tour and intercity bus service operators, and transport authorities under the IVECO BUS and HEULIEZ brands.
